# Bold, Italic, and Math Symbols

Regular text. **Bold text.** *Italic text.* ***Bold italic.***

## Math Operators

∀, ∃, ∈, ∉, ∋, ⊂, ⊃, ⊆, ⊇, ∪, ∩, ∧, ∨

## Arrows

→, ←, ↔, ⇒, ⇐, ⇔, ⇌

## Relations

≠, ≤, ≥, ≈, ≡, ∼, ∝

## Calculus

∞, ∂, ∇, ∫, ∑, ∏, √

## Letterlike Symbols

ℝ, ℤ, ℕ, ℚ, ℂ, ℏ

## Double-Struck (Math Alphanumeric)

𝕆, 𝕊

## Circled Operators and Shapes

⊗, ◁

## Superscripts and Subscripts

x⁸, H₂O

## Bold Context

**Bold with operators: ∀, ∈, →, ∞, ⊗, ◁, 𝕆, 𝕊**

## Phonetic Extensions

ᵐTc-99, ᵍ-ray
